questions.question: What is the error code for Pū Bù (Crouching Stance)?

questions.answer: Deductions are applied when: 1) The back of the thigh of the squatting leg is not in contact with the calf, 2) The extended leg is not completely straight, 3) Extended leg's foot is not turned inwards with the sole completely flat on the ground.
